content: {"a_point": "When a party appeals to the Federal Supreme Court, the written submissions must contain clear, sufficient conclusions that specify what the court is asked to decide; merely recounting facts or expressing dissatisfaction with the insurer is insufficient to meet the requirements of a valid appeal.", "b_propositions": [{"a_id": "S13", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "rule"}, {"a_id": "S13", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}]}
